Caline Caline CP-xx series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal events 2019 NAMM 2019 Caline CP-69 High Peak Distortion Published on January 13, 2019 Caline CP-xx series distortion pedal NAMM 2019 Information Caline The Caline CP-69 High Peak Distortion is a high-gain distortion pedal designed for power, versatility, and straightforward operation. It features Volume and Gain controls for setting overall output and drive intensity, along with a 3-band EQ (Bass, Mid, Treble) for precise tone shaping across the frequency spectrum. Built with a true bypass design to preserve signal integrity, the pedal is housed in a durable aluminum alloy enclosure. Its compact size makes it pedalboard-friendly while delivering a wide range of distortion tones suitable for various rock and metal styles. Controls Volume: Sets overall output level Gain: Adjusts distortion intensity Bass: Controls low frequencies Mid: Controls midrange content Treble: Controls high frequencies Technical Specifications True bypass switching Power: 9V DC, center-negative Current draw: 80 mA Dimensions: 11.2 x 6.4 x 3.4 cm Weight: 0.23 kg Aluminum alloy casing Highlights Powerful, versatile distortion with full 3-band EQ True bypass for uncolored bypass tone Compact, durable construction for pedalboard use Reviews myFXDB user reviews No reviews yet  + Add your review Links Caline Caline Caline CP-69 High Peak Distortion Where to find one?
